'''CZ-4X Assault Droids''' were [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] created by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. The droids were used to guard the Czerka facility [[CZ-198]] during the [[Seizure of CZ-198|conflict]] brought on by seizure of Czerka's assets by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Department of Adjudication]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Titans" />
